interface.longDescription: ZeroLens AI Studio provides an all-in-one suite for creative media production. Generate engaging UGC-style video advertisements, multi-panel carousel graphics, cinematic video sequences, and high-fidelity studio portraits with customizable camera motion, aspect ratios, and credit budgeting.
defaultPrompt: Create a 15-second UGC-style video ad for a skincare brand in 9:16 vertical format.
Generate a cinematic film scene with dynamic camera zoom and volumetric lighting.
Design a 5-slide educational marketing carousel for social media.
